## History

Prissy Andrews was a student at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Prior to her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) week, she stayed up half the night every night to cram for the exams.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009)_
